enchantments.tooltip: Nearly Finished: This item isn't quite finished, but it's only a step away from completion. Bring it to a Cannith Reforging Station and combine it with melted materials to restore this item to its full potential.

children.tooltip: Strength +8: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +8 Enhancement bonus to Strength.
Intelligence +8: This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +8 Enhancement bonus to Intelligence.
Charisma +8: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +8 Enhancement bonus to Charisma.

enchantments.tooltip: Improved Auto-Repair: This item has a small percentage chance to cast a Repair Serious Damage spell on you when you take damage.
Repair Amplification: This effect amplifies all incoming repair healing by +15 (Insight bonus). Includes spells, potions, and other effects.
Repair +16: Passive: +16 Competence bonus to the Repair skill.
Mythic Ring Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
